Description: Our Techunifi team recently finished deploying a modern Unonet network at Tru by Hilton Meridian, significantly upgrading the property's digital infrastructure for peak performance.

Our Techunifi team completed the phone systems and IT services at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Dawsonville, helping the property stay connected with reliable technology for both guests and staff. From the business phone system and network infrastructure to internet, Wi-Fi, user access, and device connectivity, our crew made sure everything was set up and working smoothly. 

We’re proud to add another successful project to the Techunifi portfolio. Congratulations to the property team, and we look forward to supporting them for years to come.

Our Techunifi team completed the telecom solution, setting up a reliable communication system to support the property’s daily operations. From business phone systems and SIP trunks to extensions, call routing, IVR, voicemail, and network connectivity, our crew made sure everything was set up and working smoothly. 

We’re proud to support the SpringHill Suites Boone team and look forward to keeping their communication running reliably.

Our Techunifi team completed the low-voltage hardware installation at Home2 Suites by Hilton in Pittsburg, CA, building a clean and reliable technology foundation for the property. From telecom racks and patch panels to cable management, structured cabling, and network outlets, our crew made sure everything was organized, scalable, and ready to support the property’s technology needs. 

Another property connected and ready to go! Congratulations to the  Home2 Suites team, and thank you for trusting Techunifi with your technology needs.
